\begin{example} \end{example}[Graphs as 1-dimensional CW complexes] ↗ def:cell-complex 1. ch0:0.1\group CW Complexes

A 1-dimensional CW complex is a graph: its 0-cells are vertices and its 1-cells are edges, whose two ends may attach to the same vertex. \end{example}
